notes.title: Optimisation, languages
notes.content:
The game now features a new, [u]lighter landscape system[/u].
[u]New grass[/u]: as the world building structure has changed, the appearance of the world has changed slightly, now instead of a painted plane and small grasses we have made a full-fledged large grass, it is purely decorative in nature. When buildings are placed on this grass, it is removed.

[*] NPC

[/list]

[list]
[*] the jar is not lost after spoiling the liquid
[*] reduced radius of sensitivity of monsters when the hero sleeps
[*] corrected errors in the text
[*] and other little bugs
[/list]
[h1]Added new language[/h1] - Norwegian [i](Thanks - Dita Czarnecki)[/i], the translation is incomplete, some of it is automatic, but will be finished soon.
[h1]6 new auto-translated languages:[/h1] Polish, Chinese, Korean, Italian, Japanese, Deutsch[i]
(if there's another language you'd like to see at least in auto-translate, email us and we'll add it.[/i]

notes.title: Choice of difficulty
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648661/4b0421efb285c68e2a40f87bcb6fb6da986be514.jpg[/img]
The game now has three difficulty levels: easy, normal and hard. [i](Thanks: PL-BR, Sleppy)[/i]
Previously, the game only had a hard level of difficulty.

[h3]How easy and normal modes differ from hard mode:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage from enemies is less
[*] Hunger and thirst drop slower
[*] Health from hunger and thirst drop slower
[*] Damage from poison is less
[*] Plague damage is less
[*] Dysentery disappears faster
[*] You need less sleep
[*] Sickness affects less
[*] Dirt accumulates slower
[*] Temperature has less effect on health
[*] Dehydration is weaker
[/list]

Also corrected errors in the text and in the recipe for the iron staff [i](Thanks: Psichi)[/i]

notes.title: Future changes 2
notes.content:
The following updates will contain these changes:

[list]
[*] Fruits/flowers will fall from the trees upon the first strike
[*] When digging up the soil, there will be a chance to dig up a worm, stone or ore
[*] The water filter will be simpler, it will not require a fire and iron
[*] We are going to add a stone smelter to melt ores (for example: iron and gold) hence, the mini forge will be used for other crafting purposes (for example: other blueprints and glass items)
[*] Diana will give simple recipes for cooking on a campfire
[*] A new Recipe Merchant will be available, so the player can buy other blueprints, such as: Terrarium for breeding worms, rain canopy, advanced dish recipes, etc.
[/list]

You can leave your comments under this post ^^

notes.title: Future changes on the first island.
notes.content:
We are actively working on the next island, but we will not stop updating and improving the first island.
At the request of players, the next update will include the following changes:
[list]
[*] Endurance scale for fast running of the character.
[*] Fast running of horses, with increased consumption of their food.
[*] Blacksmith with recipes for forge, iron ingot, and iron tools. On the second second island there will also be a blacksmith, but with different recipes.
[*] Help tips in the form of a window with animation. They will help you during the game.
[*] Vendor of additional recipes to help you survive. For example: baked apple, fried mushroom, garden fence, etc.
[/list]

Leave your wishes in discussions, group chat https://s.team/chat/B4aEwlt9 or send to thefarawaylandgame@gmail.com. We listen to everyone and will be happy to communicate!
